editorial_policy.current_event_interruptions: Use only when a timely event has a clear medical or public health lesson supported by authoritative sources.
editorial_policy.current_event_limit: No more than one responsive episode for every four evergreen episodes unless there is an urgent public health need.
editorial_policy.earthquake_scope: Explain injuries, crush syndrome, dust exposure, wound care, emergency triage, preparedness, and when to seek help. Do not present medicine as an explanation for tectonic causes.
editorial_policy.source_rule: Use current guidelines, official public health agencies, professional medical societies, and primary or peer reviewed literature. Every factual section must cite its source identifiers.
editorial_policy.style_rule: English, natural spoken flow, no long dash characters, no stock AI phrases, no spoken host name, no personal handle, and exactly three final takeaways.
editorial_policy.duration_rule: Target about ten minutes at the approved natural Qwen pace and stop outside five to fifteen minutes.
editorial_policy.publishing_rule: Upload only as Private. Public release always requires human review.
